display: The Emerger — Sedenion Bracketing & Firing Order
descriptive: Brackets a Cayley-Dickson 16-vector five ways with e0 held as the fixed anchor, classifies each imaginary group as C/H/O/FRAGMENT by closure, and walks the brackets in a sigma_RB-phased firing order, reporting what each grouping lets emerge and in what order -- the ascent dual of Generational Lineage.

operators.english: the real basis unit, the anchor
operators.role: never bracketed; the fixed reference every imaginary group is paired against -- the tilt to the i axis
defines closure: a group of imaginary units + e0 spans a subalgebra iff it is closed under cd_mul up to sign

operators.english: left-multiplication by x, the 16x16 matrix over Fraction
operators.role: rank(L_x) < 16 iff x is a zero divisor; exact by Gaussian elimination

operators.english: closure test on span({e0} u G)
operators.role: |G|=1 closed -> C ; 3 -> H ; 7 -> O ; else FRAGMENT (a subspace, not a subalgebra -- where zero divisors live)

operators.english: the RedBlue product s[k] = psi[k] * conj(psi[k XOR 4]), psi[k] = x[k] + i x[k+8]
operators.role: tilt = Re s (Scale channel), axis = Im s (Flow channel); Sigma_axis = 0 identically (Oblique-Gear T1); Sigma_tilt = 0 iff sigma = 1/2

operators.english: rational squash of Sigma_tilt into the 12-step precession, then mod 5
operators.role: gcd(12,5)=1, so the 12-phase clock cycles all five brackets; 12 = lcm(4 d* faces, 3 Lambert-W faces)

operators.english: purely imaginary AND norm-balanced across the CD-double boundary
operators.role: the fixed set of the J_red <-> J_blue hemisphere swap -- the balance equator the zero divisors sit on; sufficient basis-pair condition (exact locus = box_kite's 42 assessors)

ordering.english: grade x into the scalar e0 and the 15 imaginary units; this is what makes Re, the norm N = |x|^2, conjugation and the inverse well-defined. Everything after this step needs it.
split off z = x0 + i x8, the doubling-ladder pointer, from the 14-dim G_2 side. |z| is the CD-scale; |z| - Omega_ZS is the residual to the fixed point of z -> e^{-z}. Requires step 1 (needs Re).

split x into a = x[0:8] and b = x[8:16] -- J_red / J_blue, the two trees. Report |a| - |b| (signed distance from the ZD equator), the sheet, and the J_2 asymmetry ||L_x - R_x||. Requires step 1 (needs conj / norm).

extract four SU(2) phases (the four d* faces) and compute sigma_RB: tilt, axis, Sigma_tilt (= net work around the 0->p->q->N loop), Sigma_axis (= 0). Sigma_tilt = 0 marks sigma = 1/2. Refines the halves of step 3.

project x onto the annihilator block (gain 0), the unit/NOW block (gain 1) and the amplifier block (gain sqrt2); the dominant block is x's multiplicative role. Needs the norms of step 1 and the gain split; the {4:8:4} index assignment is a reading, not derived here.

verify.descriptive: Runs 14 exact self-checks of the bracketing algebra straight from the CD table; a mismatch is a code fault, not a result.

ordering.english: confirm Sigma_axis = 0 and the T1 conjugate symmetry s[k^4] = conj s[k].
confirm rank(L_{e1+e10}) < 16 -- an exact zero divisor -- and on_zd_equator = True.
confirm rank = 16 -- not a zero divisor -- and on_zd_equator = False.
enumerate the 120 firing-order permutations; confirm exactly 4 respect the dependency lattice and the canonical order is one of them.

sigma_rb.descriptive: Forms psi[k] = x[k] + i x[k+8], multiplies each by the conjugate of its XOR-4 partner, and splits the result into tilt (Scale) and axis (Flow).

ordering.english: lift the real 16-vector to psi in C^16 by pairing halves: psi[k] = x[k] + i x[(k+8) mod 16].
the RedBlue product over the XOR-4 partner pairs.

ordering.op: tilt = Re s, axis = Im s
ordering.english: tilt is XOR-4-symmetric (the Scale / Perfect-Perturbation channel); axis is XOR-4-antisymmetric (the Flow channel).
sum each. Sigma_axis = 0 by the T1 pairing; Sigma_tilt = 0 iff sigma = 1/2 (Oblique-Gear T4).
